blocks.title: On this site
blocks.footer: A site narrows what the workspace enables. It can switch a plugin off for itself, and can never switch on one the workspace has switched off.

states.label: Always on
states.text: Always on. It is what sites are built out of, so it cannot be turned off for one site any more than for the workspace.

states.label: Runs on this site
states.text: The workspace enables this plugin and this site has not turned it off, so it runs here.

states.label: Not turned on for this site
states.text: The workspace enables this plugin, but it stays off for a site until that site opts in — and this one has not.

states.label: Off for this site
states.text: The workspace enables this plugin, but this site has turned it off: it is gone from this site’s navigation, editor, published pages and API.

states.label: Off for the workspace
states.text: The workspace has this plugin switched off, so it runs on none of its sites. A site can never turn on what the workspace has turned off.
